name: Chasing Tail
detailed_description:
Welcome to Chasing Tail!


A fantasy of creatures big and small, in all shapes and sizes, peacefully live among one another. But a quiet danger threatens the tranquility of life and could potentially throw the balance into chaos. Who will stick by your side? What bonds will hold true to the end? Will love help you prevail or will hate end us all?

So what’s in this game?


This game contains a full adventure! One main overarching story and 10 main characters to date and possibly romance. Each main character contains their own story with different branches and scenes to see depending on your actions. Your input will affect now only who you spend time with and their affection towards or against you, but the game's events and outcome. Multiple side characters with there own adventures and stories can help or hamper you on your quest with additional content and bonus scenes!

The game contains 28 main chapters, 20 dates, and 8 bonus chapters with a grand word count of over half a million words to give you a plethora of content to explore!

There are 19 additional and optional NSFW scenes and content with in the game. However the game can be completed and played completely without them as the focus of the game is the story and characters.

What's next?


If you enjoyed the game (or didn't) feel free to give me feedback! Let me know which things worked for you, and which didn't. If you encounter a bug, please report it and I'll get a fix in the work right away. Constant free updates are always in the works.

A sequel is currently in development called Chasing Shadows! This new game will follow up directly after the events of Chasing Tail, and provide a brand new adventure to explore!
